claim_ceiling: Three complementary dense embedding modes characterized at minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage: 21yr/137k, center_projected_64dim AUC > 0.75 (PASSED 0.77-0.85). (2) Section Cross-Lingual: 1K sample, Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAILED. Full corpus BLOCKED. (3) Linear Hybrid Complement: 19yr/122k, w=0.3-0.4 PASS adversarial, JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79. NOT primary. Two-mode tradeoff fundamental. Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 target. No further same-question cycles justified.
evidence_summary: Citation heritage: 3 scales (21/22/24yr, 137k-158k), 100/344/730 positive pairs, all center_projected variants AUC > 0.75 (0.767-0.846). Section cross-lingual: 1K sample, 3 sections, Sachverhalt cp64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282 (PASS >0.2), Dispositiv=0.150 (PASS >0.1), Erwaegungen=0.094 (FAIL <0.1). Linear hybrids: 22yr weight sweep w=0.1-0.5, w=0.3-0.4 PASS both adversarial gates, cross-lang improvement +29% over TF-IDF. Two-mode tradeoff verified at 8 scales (3yr-165k): TF-IDF primary (JP~0.78, LangDom~0.48), Dense complementary (JP~0.43, LangDom~0.83, CiteIndep~37%), Hybrids intermediate. Negative results: Dense JP 0.05-0.43 all scales, OOS ceiling 0.53, v18 hierarchy 0.65, bge_ corpus FAIL, raw 768dim FAIL at 24yr. Data blockers: bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2024-2026 (15.5k decisions), section extraction 174k. Tests: 7/8 pass in control plane (1 blocked on external /tmp/lex_accepted evaluation artifacts).
